title: Nashik Municipal Corporation Issues Maharashtra’s 1st ULB Green Bond

items: **Maharashtra’s First ULB Green Bond:** Nashik Municipal Corporation issued and listed Maharashtra’s first Urban Local Body Green Municipal Bond on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) to finance solar energy and water recycling.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → Nashik issued Maharashtra’s 1st ULB Green Municipal Bond on NSE.
